title: A forecast band widens with its level
hook: Two stated cases: explore the normal multiplier of a prediction band.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the normal multiplier of a prediction band affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines HalfWidth, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the normal multiplier of a prediction band in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
